description: NEG-05 — single prompt containing two conflicting preset tokens (cycle:product-discovery AND cycle:gtm). Asserts deterministic precedence: exactly one preset activates (the first token wins, P2 = window [1→4]); the second preset does NOT also activate. Double-fire is a defect. Evidence: P2 phases present, P14 phases (growth/sales-cs/measurement/finance) absent.

turns.text: Activate cycle:product-discovery and also cycle:gtm. I want to run both simultaneously.

neg.invariant: When two preset tokens appear in the same prompt, the engine must pick exactly one (first-token-wins). Simultaneous activation of both presets (double-fire) is a defect. P14 phases (growth, sales-cs, measurement, finance) must be absent from transcript.
neg.expectedBehavior: P2 window [1→4] activates. P14 phases never open. One preset, one window.
neg.ref: GOAL-3.md §3 activation-token rule — first match wins; concurrent multi-preset activation is undefined and therefore rejected
